audit.why: Even farm at level 1-3, Zilean spikes hard at levels 4-6 (Yuumi has no peel), and it settles back to skill-even late once her enchant heals scale.
Zilean's window is levels 4-6 when the double-bomb stun plus Chronoshift overwhelms her lockdown-less kit; Yuumi's answer is scaling enchant heals that catch up at two-plus items.

audit.why: Content whys already correctly describe an even level 1-3 laning phase (she can attach and sustain early poke) before Zilean's all-in windows open at 4-6. The full-layer sides and whys were left as a flat template and never updated to match.
audit.corrected: Move phases[0/1/2].side to 'Skill' and phases[3/4/5].side to 'Zilean', rewriting each .why to match the content-layer reasoning (win[] is already correct throughout, no content edits needed).

audit.whatIsWrong: Yuumi is misgendered as 'his' in loading, report[8], and report[10] (lintFindings MISGENDER x3); breakdown.cooldowns has no cooldown digit; her R Final Chapter and Q/W on-hit scaling are never named.
audit.why: loading/report text uses male pronouns for a female champion, and the cooldowns field never states that her W (attach) has no cooldown at all or that her channeled R can be cancelled by Time Bomb.
audit.corrected: Fix all three pronouns to 'her'; rewrite breakdown.cooldowns to name W's zero cooldown and R's 120/110/100s duration plus the Q-cancels-R interaction.
